::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 70,198 people lived in County Sligo, up 7.1% on 2016. It had the 22nd largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 39% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Sligo was €1,156, the 18th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Sligo

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Sligo was €26,887, the 18th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Sligo was €285,100, the 16th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 5.6 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Sligo, the 11th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 28% of households in County Sligo rented their home, the 9th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 17% of people living in County Sligo were born outside Ireland, the 18th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 42% of people aged 3 and over in County Sligo said they could speak Irish, the 12th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 30% of people at work in County Sligo worked from home for at least part of the week, the 11th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 76% of people travelling to work in County Sligo went by car, the 17th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Sligo live more than 2.4 km by road from a GP, the 13th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Sligo live more than 12.8 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 23rd furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 12.7% of County Sligo in 2021, the 6th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
